# Nordic

Nordic presents a Nord-inspired interface in selectable Default, Light, Dark and Uniform light and dark flavors, keeping one Nord color palette across Obsidian. It ships optional styles for the Fantasy and Statblocks plugins and uses the Manrope and Norwester fonts.

![Nordic screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/natowb/obsidian-nordic/HEAD/obsidian-nordic.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Nordic"
    author: "natowb"
    repo:   "natowb/obsidian-nordic"
    slug:   "nordic"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/nordic"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/natowb/obsidian-nordic"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/natowb/obsidian-nordic/HEAD/obsidian-nordic.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Nord-inspired interface with selectable Default, Light, Dark and Uniform light/dark flavors for a consistent Nord color palette across Obsidian. Include optional styles for Fantasy and Statblocks plugins and use Manrope and Norwester fonts for clean typography."
}
```
